description: Create retester.py (automatic retest engine), diff_engine.py (scan comparison), and attack_planner.py (attack path planning). The retester checks if findings are still present. The diff_engine compares two scans to detect changes. The attack_planner generates exploitation scenarios from correlated findings.
steps: Create /projects/sandbox/Bug-Bounty/super_monster/retester.py (~2000 lines): RetestEngine class. Load previous findings from FindingDB. For each finding, reconstruct the appropriate test based on finding_type: CORS=re-send request with same Origin header and check Access-Control-Allow-Origin, Missing headers=re-fetch URL and check response headers, SSL issues=re-check certificate via ssl module, Cookie issues=re-fetch and check Set-Cookie attributes, Subdomain takeover=re-resolve DNS and check response body fingerprint, Information disclosure=re-check server/powered-by headers. Compare old vs new results. Status enum: STILL_PRESENT, FIXED, CHANGED, UNKNOWN. Retest strategies: full (everything), critical_only (HIGH/CRITICAL only), oldest_first (longest since last check), random_sample (20% random). Track last_tested timestamp for each finding. Suggest retest intervals based on severity (CRITICAL=daily, HIGH=3 days, MEDIUM=weekly, LOW=monthly). Generate diff report showing what changed. Professional colored output with stats (% fixed, % still present, days unfixed). Cron-compatible schedule generation.

Create /projects/sandbox/Bug-Bounty/super_monster/diff_engine.py (~800 lines): DiffEngine class. Compare two Monster scan result directories/files. Detect: new findings (not in old scan), removed findings (in old but not new = fixed), changed findings (severity or evidence changed), new subdomains appeared, technology changes, certificate changes. Output unified diff report with clear sections. Color-coded additions (green) and removals (red). Summary statistics.

Create /projects/sandbox/Bug-Bounty/super_monster/attack_planner.py (~1500 lines): AttackPlanner class. Input: correlated findings from CorrelationEngine. Build attack graph: nodes are states (unauthenticated, authenticated, admin, data access, etc.), edges are exploits/findings. Find shortest path from 'unauthenticated attacker' to 'critical impact'. Generate step-by-step exploitation plans with numbered steps. Create ASCII art attack tree visualization showing branches and paths. Suggest tools for each step (burp, curl commands, etc.). Generate combined PoC templates for attack chains (shell commands, curl requests). Risk assessment for each path (likelihood, impact, complexity).
acceptance_criteria: RetestEngine can load findings and generate appropriate HTTP-based retest requests for each finding type
RetestEngine produces retest report with status breakdown (STILL_PRESENT, FIXED, CHANGED, UNKNOWN)
RetestEngine supports all four strategies: full, critical_only, oldest_first, random_sample
RetestEngine tracks last_tested timestamps and suggests retest intervals
DiffEngine compares two scan results and identifies new/removed/changed findings
DiffEngine produces color-coded diff report with summary statistics
AttackPlanner builds attack graph from correlated findings and generates exploitation plans
AttackPlanner produces ASCII art attack tree visualization
AttackPlanner generates PoC templates (curl commands) for attack chains
python -m super_monster retest --input ./monster_output/reports --strategy full runs without error
python -m super_monster plan --input ./monster_output/reports --output ./test_plan runs without error
